title: Meaning of clinical calculator results: a cross-sectional analysis of the MDCalc catalogue — data and code
description:
Frozen aggregate analytic datasets and analysis code supporting Meaning of clinical calculator results: a cross-sectional analysis of the MDCalc catalogue, submitted to BMJ Evidence-Based Medicine (bmjebm-2026-115053).

The 11 August 2026 data freeze contains 482 primary evaluations representing 407 calculators in a catalogue of 847 calculators. Includes extracted numerical inputs, cleaned primary and expanded datasets, a row-level audit, source citations, analysis scripts, result summaries, a data dictionary and file checksums.

The four CSV datasets match the submitted reproducibility archive. The original extraction workbook contains third-party text and is excluded from this public release. Reproduction from the included derived data is supported; reconstruction from the original workbook additionally requires that excluded input. These are aggregate study-level data, not patient-level records.

First-party data and documentation: CC BY 4.0. Original software: MIT. Third-party material retains its original terms. See LICENSE.md for scope. Code release 0.3.0 preserves the submitted scientific data and calculations.
